parserNote: stripPrefix removes the three wrapper classes the site puts first on explainer figures (fig, xwide, wide), so a figure is named from its explainer class (board, code, video, shot, lab, cmp, vs, swr...) instead of collapsing 210 figures into one name; a bare div.wide wrapper then reads as a shape label. The last alternative turns row-list into rowlist: the parser reads a row- prefix as a utility class, which would merge the Related row list into plain ordered lists.
